The graph of the polynomial $y=F(x)$ is shown above. Which of the following statements are true?

- The degree of $F(x)$ is odd.
- The degree of $F(x)$ is even.
- The coefficient of the leading term is positive.
worked_solution:
The end behavior of $F(x)$ is

- $F(x)\to \infty $ as $x\to \infty ,$ and

- $F(x)\to -\infty $ as $x\to -\infty .$

Consequently, 

- the degree of $F(x)$ is odd, and

- the leading coefficient of $F(x)$ is positive.

So II is false, and I and III are true.
